title: Building Habits
summary: Habits stick when they're small, specific and tied to an existing cue ('after I brush, I'll stretch for 2 minutes'). Tracking progress and not missing twice in a row help.
answer_guidance: Explain clearly and simply in the user's language; give steps or examples when the user asks how.
